name: exile-appraiser
description: Path of Exile 查價工具(繁中/英文客戶端,國際服與台服;PoE1 + PoE2)

scripts.test: npm run verify-data && npm run test --workspace core && npm run test --workspace poe1 && npm run test --workspace poe2 && npm run test --workspace regex && npm run test --workspace renderer && npm run test --workspace main
scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace renderer & npm run dev --workspace main
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace renderer && npm run build --workspace main
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package --workspace main
